court_service_reason.name: court_service_reason
court_service_reason.value: ("court_service"."paused" AND length(btrim("court_service"."reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "court_service"."reason" IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT "court_service"."paused" AND "court_service"."reason" IS NULL)

order_source_valid.name: order_source_valid
order_source_valid.value: ("customer_order"."source" = 'guest' AND "customer_order"."created_by" IS NULL) OR ("customer_order"."source" = 'counter' AND "customer_order"."created_by" IS NOT NULL)

order_contact_valid.name: order_contact_valid
order_contact_valid.value: length(btrim("customer_order"."customer_name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND ("customer_order"."kind" <> 'court' OR ("customer_order"."phone" IS NOT NULL AND length("customer_order"."phone") BETWEEN 8 AND 30))

order_location_valid.name: order_location_valid
order_location_valid.value: ("customer_order"."kind" = 'pickup' AND "customer_order"."location_id" IS NULL AND "customer_order"."pickup_code" IS NOT NULL) OR ("customer_order"."kind" IN ('court', 'dine_in') AND "customer_order"."location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_order"."pickup_code" IS NULL)

court_workflow_valid.name: court_workflow_valid
court_workflow_valid.value: ("customer_order"."evidence_mode" = 'demo' AND "customer_order"."demo_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_order"."public_reference" IS NULL) OR ("customer_order"."evidence_mode" = 'court_test' AND "customer_order"."source" = 'guest' AND "customer_order"."kind" = 'court' AND "customer_order"."demo_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "customer_order"."public_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_order"."public_reference" ~ '^LB-[A-F0-9]{10}$')

order_deadlines_valid.name: order_deadlines_valid
order_deadlines_valid.value: (("customer_order"."evidence_mode" = 'demo' AND "customer_order"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_order"."expires_at" > "customer_order"."created_at" AND "customer_order"."expires_at" <= "customer_order"."created_at" + interval '15 minutes') OR ("customer_order"."evidence_mode" = 'court_test' AND "customer_order"."expires_at" IS NULL)) AND "customer_order"."access_expires_at" > "customer_order"."created_at" AND "customer_order"."access_expires_at" <= "customer_order"."created_at" + interval '24 hours'

preparation_fields_valid.name: preparation_fields_valid
preparation_fields_valid.value: ("customer_order"."preparation_assignee_id" IS NULL AND "customer_order"."preparation_claimed_at" IS NULL AND "customer_order"."preparation_ready_at" IS NULL AND "customer_order"."state" NOT IN ('preparing','ready')) OR ("customer_order"."evidence_mode" = 'court_test' AND "customer_order"."preparation_assignee_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_order"."preparation_claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_order"."preparation_claimed_at" >= "customer_order"."created_at" AND (("customer_order"."state" IN ('preparing','exception') AND "customer_order"."preparation_ready_at" IS NULL) OR ("customer_order"."state" = 'ready' AND "customer_order"."preparation_ready_at" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_order"."preparation_ready_at" >= "customer_order"."preparation_claimed_at")))

location_table_number_valid.name: location_table_number_valid
location_table_number_valid.value: ("location"."kind" = 'court' AND "location"."table_number" IS NULL) OR ("location"."kind" = 'table' AND "location"."table_number" IS NOT NULL AND "location"."table_number" > 0 AND "location"."name" = "location"."table_number"::text)

preparation_command_kind.name: preparation_command_kind
preparation_command_kind.value: ("preparation_command"."kind" IN ('claim','ready','hold') AND "preparation_command"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "preparation_command"."service_version" IS NULL) OR ("preparation_command"."kind" IN ('pause','resume') AND "preparation_command"."order_id" IS NULL AND "preparation_command"."service_version" > 1 AND "preparation_command"."service_version" IS NOT NULL)

preparation_command_reason.name: preparation_command_reason
preparation_command_reason.value: ("preparation_command"."kind" IN ('hold','pause') AND "preparation_command"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("preparation_command"."reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200) OR ("preparation_command"."kind" NOT IN ('hold','pause') AND "preparation_command"."reason" IS NULL)

product_translation_valid.name: product_translation_valid
product_translation_valid.value: ("product"."name_en" IS NULL OR length(btrim("product"."name_en")) BETWEEN 1 AND 120) AND ("product"."category_en" IS NULL OR length(btrim("product"."category_en")) BETWEEN 1 AND 60) AND ("product"."description_en" IS NULL OR length("product"."description_en") <= 500)
